verdict.rationale: A natural-language command interface is a reasonable thing to ask of a notarization and incorporation SaaS, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only a REST API, webhooks, llms.txt documentation files and AI-powered signature-field detection, with no chat or natural-language way to operate the product. The llms.txt files and the API are building blocks an agent could use, and AI field detection is an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit for this story.
